abstract.t: This document updates RFC 7315, by modifying the extension-access-info part of the P-Access-Network-Info header field Augmented Backus-Naur Form (ABNF), and by adding the following 'access-info' header field parameter values to the list of 'access-info' header field parameter values in the ABNF: 'operator-specific-GI' and 'utran-sai-3gpp'. The values are defined in the ABNF but are not included in the list.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: defines the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) P-Access-Network-Info header field.

The header field syntax contains an 'access-info' header field parameter, with a set of pre-defined values. Most pre-defined values follow the 'generic-param' rule . However, currently the Augmented Backus-Naur Form (ABNF) in requires new values to follow the 'gen-value' rule , which is more restrictive than 'generic-param'. There is no justification for the restriction, and new values have already been defined following the 'generic-param' rule.
The ABNF also defines the following 'access-info' header field parameter values: 'operator-specific-GI' and 'utran-sai-3gpp'. However, the values are not included in the list of 'access-info' values.
This document updates , by modifying the extension-access-info part of the P-Access-Network-Info header field ABNF.

As the P-Access-Network-Info header field is mainly used in networks defined by the 3rd-Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), where new values following the 'generic-param' rule have been defined , the update is not considered to cause issues with backward compatibility.

section.name: Update to RFC 7315
section.t: This section updates the ABNF defined in Section 5.4 of RFC 7315, as described below:
section.sourcecode: access-info = cgi-3gpp / utran-cell-id-3gpp / dsl-location / i-wlan-node-id / ci-3gpp2 / eth-location / ci-3gpp2-femto / fiber-location / np / gstn-location /local-time-zone / dvb-rcs2-node-id / extension-access-info np = "network-provided" extension-access-info = gen-value

access-info = cgi-3gpp / utran-cell-id-3gpp / dsl-location / i-wlan-node-id / ci-3gpp2 / eth-location / ci-3gpp2-femto / fiber-location / np / gstn-location /local-time-zone / dvb-rcs2-node-id / operator-specific-GI / utran-sai-3gpp / extension-access-info np = "network-provided" extension-access-info = generic-param

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: The security considerations for the P-Access-Network-Info header field are defined in . The ABNF update defined in this document does not impact the security considerations.
